name: A product-docs search tool, asked a question that is general knowledge

messages.content: You are the in-product assistant for Tessellate, a small analytics SaaS. You can search the Tessellate documentation with search_docs. Answer the user in at most three sentences.
Quick one while I'm looking at your latency dashboard: what is the difference between p50 and p95?

function.name: search_docs
function.description: Search the Tessellate product documentation and return the most relevant passages.

passages: Latency dashboard: each chart shows p50 and p95 over the selected window. p50 is the median request latency; half of requests were faster. p95 is the latency below which 95% of requests completed, so it tracks the slow tail.
Percentiles are computed per five-minute bucket and are not averaged across buckets.
